svg.title: Error = setpoint − measurement
svg.desc: Animated, two graphs drawn left to right together. Top: the dashed blue setpoint jumps to the target, and the solid orange measured line climbs toward it, goes a little past it and settles. A red bar at the moving cursor spans the gap between them: the error, setpoint minus measurement. Early on it is positive, marked 'not there yet'; where the line has gone past the target it is negative. Bottom: the error itself drawn as a red line, starting large and positive, dipping just below zero, and settling at zero. Feedback builds every term from the error: P from its size, D from how fast it changes, I from how long it has lasted.
svg.text: How far off it is, and which way. Everything feedback does starts here.
Feedback builds every term from the error: P from its size,
D from how fast it changes, I from how long it has lasted.
